scope: Six selected rows: five exact-grading internal confirmations and one semantic duplicate consolidated, not a contiguous/full-category audit.

retained.sourceClaim: The SI prefix kilo represents a factor of one thousand, or 10^3. This is the decimal metric prefix, not the binary prefix kibi.
distractorReview: 10000 is 10^4, not kilo.
100 is hecto.
1000 is kilo.
1000000 is mega.
retained.contextDecision: Exact prompt/options/key and provisional imported difficulty retained. Internal primary-source check only; no independent review or difficulty calibration claimed.

retained.sourceClaim: IMAP expands to Internet Message Access Protocol. It lets a mail client work with messages and mailboxes stored on a server; sending outgoing mail is a separate function.
distractorReview: Intelligent Message Account Process is not the standardized name.
Internet Massive Access Peak is not the standardized name.
Internet Message Access Protocol is the RFC title.
Intelligent Messaging Account Protocol is not the standardized name.
retained.contextDecision: Exact prompt/options/key and provisional imported difficulty retained. Internal primary-source check only; no independent review or difficulty calibration claimed.

retained.sourceClaim: FTP stands for File Transfer Protocol and can transfer files between computers. The expansion does not imply that ordinary FTP encrypts a connection or is the best choice for sensitive transfers.
distractorReview: File To Person is not the protocol name.
File Transfer Protocol is the RFC name.
Fast Transfer Protocol is not the name.
Full Transfer Protocol is not the name.
retained.contextDecision: Exact prompt/options/key and provisional imported difficulty retained. Internal primary-source check only; no independent review or difficulty calibration claimed.

retained.sourceClaim: WWW abbreviates World Wide Web. The Web is the linked information system accessed with browsers; it is not another name for every service on the Internet.
distractorReview: Wild Wonderful World is not the W3C expansion.
World Wide Web is the identified expansion.
Whole World Web is not the identified name.
World War Web is not the identified name.
retained.contextDecision: Exact prompt/options/key and provisional imported difficulty retained. Internal primary-source check only; no independent review or difficulty calibration claimed.

retained.sourceClaim: The SI prefix nano represents one billionth, or 10^-9. For example, a nanometer is one billionth of a meter.
distractorReview: One billionth is 10^-9, nano.
10 is deca.
1000000 is mega.
retained.contextDecision: Exact prompt/options/key and provisional imported difficulty retained. Internal primary-source check only; no independent review or difficulty calibration claimed.
